5. export function registerModule(
6.   store: Store<any>,
7.   path: string | string[],
8.   namespace: string | null,
9.   module: Module<any, any, any, any>,
10.   options?: ModuleOptions
11. ): void {
12.   const normalizedPath = typeof path === 'string' ? [path] : path
13.   const { options: moduleOptions, injectStore } = module.create(
14.     normalizedPath,
15.     normalizeNamespace(namespace)
16.   )
17.   store.registerModule(normalizedPath, moduleOptions, options)
18.   injectStore(store)
19. }

21. export function unregisterModule(
22.   store: Store<any>,
23.   module: Module<any, any, any, any>
24. ): void {
25.   assert(module.path, 'The module seems not registered in the store')
26.   store.unregisterModule(module.path!)
27. }

29. function normalizeNamespace(namespace: string | null): string {
30.   if (namespace === '' || namespace === null) {
31.     return ''
32.   }
33. 
34.   return namespace[namespace.length - 1] === '/' ? namespace : namespace + '/'
35. }

197.       injectStore: combine(
198.         children ? children.injectStore : noop,
199.         gettersInstance ? gettersInstance.injectStore : noop,
200.         mutationsInstance ? mutationsInstance.injectStore : noop,
201.         actionsInstance ? actionsInstance.injectStore : noop

207. function initGetters<
208.   S,
209.   G extends BG<S>,
210.   M extends BM<S>,
211.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
212. >(
213.   Getters: Class<G>,
214.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
215. ): { getters: GetterTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
216.   const getters: any = new Getters()
217.   const options: GetterTree<any, any> = {}
218. 
219.   // Proxy all getters to print useful warning on development
220.   function proxyGetters(getters: any, origin: string): any {
221.     const proxy = Object.create(getters)
222.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
223.       Object.defineProperty(proxy, key, {
224.         get() {
225.           error(
226.             `You are accessing ${Getters.name}#${key} from ${Getters.name}#${origin}` +
227.               ' but direct access to another getter is prohibitted.' +
228.               ` Access it via this.getters.${key} instead.`
229.           )
230.           return getters[key]
231.         },
232.         configurable: true
233.       })
234.     })
235.     return proxy
236.   }
237. 
238.   traverseDescriptors(Getters.prototype, BaseGetters, (desc, key) => {
239.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function' && !desc.get) {
240.       return
241.     }
242. 
243.     const methodFn = desc.value
244.     const getterFn = desc.get
245. 
246.     options[key] = () => {
247.       const proxy =
248.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
249.           ? getters
250.           : proxyGetters(getters, key)
251. 
252.       if (getterFn) {
253.         return getterFn.call(proxy)
254.       }
255. 
256.       if (methodFn) {
257.         return methodFn.bind(proxy)
258.       }
259.     }
260.   })
261. 
262.   return {
263.     getters: options,
264.     injectStore: store => {
265.       const context = module.context(store)
266. 
267.       Object.defineProperty(getters, '__ctx__', {
268.         get: () => context
269.       })
270. 
271.       getters.$init(store)
272.     }
273.   }
274. }

276. function initMutations<
277.   S,
278.   G extends BG<S>,
279.   M extends BM<S>,
280.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
281. >(
282.   Mutations: Class<M>,
283.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
284. ): { mutations: MutationTree<any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
285.   const mutations: any = new Mutations()
286.   const options: MutationTree<any> = {}
287. 
288.   // Proxy all mutations to print useful warning on development
289.   function proxyMutations(mutations: any, origin: string): any {

291.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
292.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
293.         error(
294.           `You are accessing ${Mutations.name}#${key} from ${Mutations.name}#${origin}` +
295.             ' but accessing another mutation is prohibitted.' +
296.             ' Use an action to consolidate the mutation chain.'
297.         )
298.         mutations[key].apply(mutations, args)
299.       }
300.     })
301.     return proxy
302.   }
303. 
304.   traverseDescriptors(Mutations.prototype, BaseMutations, (desc, key) => {
305.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
306.       return
307.     }
308. 
309.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {
310.       const proxy =
311.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
312.           ? mutations
313.           : proxyMutations(mutations, key)
314. 
315.       return mutations[key].call(proxy, payload)
316.     }
317.   })
318. 
319.   return {
320.     mutations: options,
321.     injectStore: store => {
322.       const context = module.context(store)
323.       Object.defineProperty(mutations, '__ctx__', {
324.         get: () => context
325.       })
326.     }
327.   }
328. }

330. function initActions<

332.   G extends BG<S>,
333.   M extends BM<S>,
334.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
335. >(
336.   Actions: Class<A>,
337.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>

339.   const actions: any = new Actions()
340.   const options: ActionTree<any, any> = {}
341. 
342.   // Proxy all actions to print useful warning on development
343.   function proxyActions(actions: any, origin: string): any {

346.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
347.         error(
348.           `You are accessing ${Actions.name}#${key} from ${Actions.name}#${origin}` +
349.             ' but direct access to another action is prohibitted.' +
350.             ` Access it via this.dispatch('${key}') instead.`
351.         )
352.         actions[key].apply(actions, args)

354.     })
355.     return proxy

361.     }

12. export interface Commit<M> {

14.   <K extends keyof M>(
15.     type: K,
16.     payload: Payload<M[K]>,
17.     options?: CommitOptions
18.   ): void

23.   ): void

25.   <K extends { [K in keyof M]: M[K] extends () => any ? K : never }[keyof M]>(

27.   ): void
28. }

38.   <K extends keyof A>(
39.     payload: Payload<A[K]> & { type: K },
40.     options?: DispatchOptions
41.   ): Promise<any>
42.   // no payload (only actions without parameters)
43.   <K extends { [K in keyof A]: A[K] extends () => any ? K : never }[keyof A]>(
44.     type: K
45.   ): Promise<any>
46. }

48. type State<Mod extends Module<any, any, any, any>> = Mod extends Module<
49.   infer R,
50.   any,
51.   any,
52.   any
53. >
54.   ? R
55.   : never

61.   any
62. >

67.   any,
68.   any,
69.   infer R,
70.   any
71. >
72.   ? R
73.   : never

77.   any,

84. export interface ContextPosition {
85.   path: string[]
86.   namespace: string
87. }

89. export function createLazyContextPosition(
90.   module: Module<any, any, any, any>
91. ): ContextPosition {
92.   const message =
93.     'The module need to be registered a store before using `Module#context` or `createMapper`'
94. 
95.   return {
96.     get path() {
97.       assert(module.path !== undefined, message)
98.       return module.path!
99.     },
100. 
101.     get namespace() {
102.       assert(module.namespace !== undefined, message)
103.       return module.namespace!
104.     }
105.   }

108. function normalizedDispatch(
109.   dispatch: Function,
110.   namespace: string,
111.   type: any,
112.   payload: any,
113.   options?: any
114. ): any {
115.   if (typeof type === 'string') {
116.     return dispatch(namespace + type, payload, options)
117.   } else {
118.     return dispatch(
119.       {
120.         ...type,
121.         type: namespace + type.type
122.       },
123.       payload
124.     )
125.   }
126. }

128. export function commit(
129.   store: Store<any>,
130.   namespace: string,
131.   type: any,
132.   payload: any,
133.   options?: any
134. ): void {
135.   normalizedDispatch(store.commit, namespace, type, payload, options)
136. }
137. 
138. export function dispatch(
139.   store: Store<any>,
140.   namespace: string,
141.   type: any,
142.   payload: any,
143.   options?: any
144. ): Promise<any> {
145.   return normalizedDispatch(store.dispatch, namespace, type, payload, options)
146. }

148. export function getters(store: Store<any>, namespace: string): any {
149.   const sliceIndex = namespace.length
150.   const getters: Record<string, any> = {}
151. 
152.   Object.keys(store.getters).forEach(key => {
153.     const sameNamespace = namespace === key.slice(0, sliceIndex)
154.     const name = key.slice(sliceIndex)
155.     if (!sameNamespace || !name) {
156.       return
157.     }
158. 
159.     Object.defineProperty(getters, name, {
160.       get: () => store.getters[key],
161.       enumerable: true
162.     })
163.   })
164. 
165.   return getters
166. }

168. export class Context<Mod extends Module<any, any, any, any>> {
169.   private __mutations__?: Committer<Mutations<Mod>>
170.   private __actions__?: Dispatcher<Actions<Mod>>
171.   /** @internal */
172.   constructor(
173.     private pos: ContextPosition,
174.     private store: Store<any>,
175.     private mutationsClass: Class<unknown> | undefined,
176.     private actionsClass: Class<unknown> | undefined
177.   ) {}
178. 
179.   get mutations(): Committer<Mutations<Mod>> {
180.     if (this.__mutations__) {
181.       return this.__mutations__
182.     }
183.     const mutations: Record<string, any> = {}
184.     if (this.mutationsClass) {
185.       const mutationNames = gatherHandlerNames(
186.         this.mutationsClass.prototype,
187.         BaseMutations
188.       )
189.       mutationNames.forEach(name => {
190.         Object.defineProperty(mutations, name, {
191.           value: (payload: any) => this.commit(name, payload),
192.           enumerable: true
193.         })
194.       })
195.     }
196.     return (this.__mutations__ = mutations as any)
197.   }
198. 
199.   get actions(): Dispatcher<Actions<Mod>> {
200.     if (this.__actions__) {
201.       return this.__actions__
202.     }
203.     const actions: Record<string, any> = {}
204.     if (this.actionsClass) {
205.       const actionNames = gatherHandlerNames(
206.         this.actionsClass.prototype,
207.         BaseActions
208.       )
209.       actionNames.forEach(name => {
210.         Object.defineProperty(actions, name, {
211.           value: (payload: any) => this.dispatch(name, payload),
212.           enumerable: true
213.         })
214.       })
215.     }
216.     return (this.__actions__ = actions as any)
217.   }
218. 
219.   commit: Commit<Mutations<Mod>> = (
220.     type: any,
221.     payload?: any,
222.     options?: any
223.   ): void => {
224.     return commit(this.store, this.pos.namespace, type, payload, options)
225.   }
226. 
227.   dispatch: Dispatch<Actions<Mod>> = (
228.     type: any,
229.     payload?: any,
230.     options?: any
231.   ): any => {
232.     return dispatch(this.store, this.pos.namespace, type, payload, options)
233.   }
234. 
235.   get state(): State<Mod> {
236.     return get(this.pos.path, this.store.state)
237.   }
238. 
239.   get getters(): Getters<Mod> {
240.     return getters(this.store, this.pos.namespace)
241.   }
242. }

6. interface Class<T> {

10. export function inject<G extends Getters<S>, S>(
11.   Getters: Class<G>,
12.   injection: Partial<G & { state: S; getters: G }>

19.   Actions: Class<A>,
20.   injection: Partial<A & { state: S; getters: G; dispatch: any; commit: any }>
21. ): A
22. export function inject<T>(
23.   F: Class<T>,
24.   injection: Partial<T> & Record<string, any>
25. ): T {
26.   const proto = F.prototype
27. 
28.   const descs: PropertyDescriptorMap = {}
29.   Object.keys(injection).forEach(key => {
30.     descs[key] = {
31.       configurable: true,
32.       enumerable: true,
33.       writable: true,
34.       value: injection[key]
35.     }
36.   })
37. 
38.   return Object.create(proto, descs)
39. }

41. export class Getters<S = {}> {
42.   /* @internal */
43.   __ctx__!: Context<Module<S, this, any, any>>
44. 
45.   $init(_store: Store<any>): void {}
46. 
47.   protected get state(): S {
48.     return this.__ctx__.state
49.   }
50. 
51.   protected get getters(): this {
52.     return this.__ctx__.getters
53.   }
54. }

56. export class Mutations<S = {}> {
57.   /* @internal */
58.   __ctx__!: Context<Module<S, any, any, any>>
59. 
60.   protected get state(): S {
61.     return this.__ctx__.state
62.   }
63. }

65. export class Actions<
66.   S = {},
67.   G extends BG<S> = BG<S>,
68.   M extends BM<S> = BM<S>,
69.   A = {} // We need to specify self action type explicitly to infer dispatch type.
70. > {
71.   /* @internal */
72.   __ctx__!: Context<Module<S, G, M, any>>
73. 
74.   $init(_store: Store<any>): void {}
75. 
76.   protected get state(): S {
77.     return this.__ctx__.state
78.   }
79. 
80.   protected get getters(): G {
81.     return this.__ctx__.getters
82.   }
83. 
84.   protected get commit(): Commit<M> {
85.     return this.__ctx__.commit
86.   }
87. 
88.   protected get dispatch(): Dispatch<A> {
89.     return this.__ctx__.dispatch
90.   }
91. 
92.   /**
93.    * IMPORTANT: Each action type maybe incorrect - return type of all actions should be `Promise<any>`
94.    * but the ones under `actions` are same as what you declared in this actions class.
95.    * The reason why we declare the type in such way is to avoid recursive type error.
96.    * See: https://github.com/ktsn/vuex-smart-module/issues/30
97.    */

100.   }
101. 
102.   protected get mutations(): Committer<M> {

104.   }
105. }

108.   [K in keyof M]: Payload<M[K]> extends never

111. }

127.   ? P
128.   : never

24.   injection: Partial<T> & Record<string, any>
25. ): T {
26.   const proto = F.prototype
27. 
28.   const descs: PropertyDescriptorMap = {}
29.   Object.keys(injection).forEach(key => {
30.     descs[key] = {
31.       configurable: true,
32.       enumerable: true,
33.       writable: true,
34.       value: injection[key]
35.     }
36.   })
37. 
38.   return Object.create(proto, descs)
39. }

41. export class Getters<S = {}> {
42.   /* @internal */
43.   __ctx__!: Context<Module<S, this, any, any>>
44. 
45.   $init(_store: Store<any>): void {}
46. 
47.   protected get state(): S {
48.     return this.__ctx__.state
49.   }
50. 
51.   protected get getters(): this {
52.     return this.__ctx__.getters
53.   }
54. }
55. 
56. export class Mutations<S = {}> {
57.   /* @internal */
58.   __ctx__!: Context<Module<S, any, any, any>>
59. 
60.   protected get state(): S {
61.     return this.__ctx__.state
62.   }
63. }

65. export class Actions<
66.   S = {},
67.   G extends BG<S> = BG<S>,
68.   M extends BM<S> = BM<S>,
69.   A = {} // We need to specify self action type explicitly to infer dispatch type.
70. > {
71.   /* @internal */
72.   __ctx__!: Context<Module<S, G, M, any>>
73. 
74.   $init(_store: Store<any>): void {}
75. 
76.   protected get state(): S {
77.     return this.__ctx__.state
78.   }
79. 
80.   protected get getters(): G {
81.     return this.__ctx__.getters
82.   }
83. 
84.   protected get commit(): Commit<M> {
85.     return this.__ctx__.commit
86.   }
87. 
88.   protected get dispatch(): Dispatch<A> {

90.   }
91.

98.   protected get actions(): A {

100.   }
101. 
102.   protected get mutations(): Committer<M> {

104.   }
105. }

107. export type Committer<M> = {
108.   [K in keyof M]: Payload<M[K]> extends never
109.     ? never
110.     : MappedFunction<M[K], void>
111. }
112. 
113. export type Dispatcher<A> = {
114.   [K in keyof A]: Payload<A[K]> extends never
115.     ? never
116.     : MappedFunction<A[K], Promise<any>>
117. }

120. export type BG<S> = Getters<S>
121. export type BM<S> = Mutations<S>
122. export type BA<S, G extends BG<S>, M extends BM<S>> = Actions<S, G, M>
123. 
124. export type Payload<T> = T extends (payload?: infer P) => any
125.   ? P | undefined
126.   : T extends (payload: infer P) => any
127.   ? P
128.   : never

1. import {

3.   Module as VuexModule,
4.   GetterTree,
5.   MutationTree,
6.   ActionTree

13.   BG,

20.   noop,
21.   combine,

28. 
29. export interface ModuleOptions<
30.   S,
31.   G extends BG<S>,
32.   M extends BM<S>,
33.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
34. > {
35.   namespaced?: boolean
36.   state?: Class<S>
37.   getters?: Class<G>
38.   mutations?: Class<M>
39.   actions?: Class<A>
40.   modules?: Record<string, Module<any, any, any, any>>

42. 
43. interface ModuleInstance {
44.   options: VuexModule<any, any>
45.   injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void
46. }

48. export class Module<
49.   S,
50.   G extends BG<S>,
51.   M extends BM<S>,
52.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
53. > {
54.   /* @internal */
55.   path: string[] | undefined
56. 
57.   /* @internal */
58.   namespace: string | undefined
59. 
60.   private mapper: ComponentMapper<S, G, M, A> = new ComponentMapper<S, G, M, A>(
61.     createLazyContextPosition(this)
62.   )
63. 
64.   constructor(public options: ModuleOptions<S, G, M, A> = {}) {}
65. 
66.   clone(): Module<S, G, M, A> {
67.     const options = { ...this.options }
68.     if (options.modules) {
69.       options.modules = mapValues(options.modules, m => m.clone())
70.     }
71.     return new Module(options)
72.   }

74.   context(store: Store<any>): Context<this> {
75.     return new Context(
76.       createLazyContextPosition(this),
77.       store,
78.       this.options.mutations,
79.       this.options.actions
80.     )
81.   }

83.   mapState<K extends keyof S>(map: K[]): { [Key in K]: () => S[Key] }

85.     map: T
86.   ): { [Key in keyof T]: () => S[T[Key] & keyof S] }

101.     return this.mapper.mapGetters(map)

116.     deprecated(
117.       '`Module#mapMutations` is deprecated. Use `createMapper` instead.'
118.     )
119.     return this.mapper.mapMutations(map)
120.   }

126.     map: T
127.   ): { [Key in keyof T]: MappedFunction<A[T[Key] & keyof A], Promise<any>> }

138.   /* @internal */
139.   create(path: string[], namespace: string): ModuleInstance {
140.     assert(
141.       !this.path || this.path.join('.') === path.join('.'),
142.       'You are reusing one module on multiple places in the same store.\n' +
143.         'Clone it by `module.clone()` method to make sure every module in the store is unique.'
144.     )
145. 
146.     this.path = path
147.     this.namespace = namespace
148. 
149.     const {
150.       namespaced,
151.       state,
152.       getters,
153.       mutations,
154.       actions,
155.       modules
156.     } = this.options
157. 
158.     const children = !modules
159.       ? undefined
160.       : Object.keys(modules).reduce(
161.           (acc, key) => {
162.             const m = modules[key]
163.             const nextNamespaced =
164.               m.options.namespaced === undefined ? true : m.options.namespaced
165. 
166.             const nextNamespaceKey = nextNamespaced ? key + '/' : ''
167. 
168.             const res = m.create(
169.               path.concat(key),
170.               namespaced ? namespace + nextNamespaceKey : nextNamespaceKey
171.             )
172. 
173.             acc.options[key] = res.options
174.             acc.injectStore = combine(acc.injectStore, res.injectStore)
175. 
176.             return acc
177.           },
178.           {
179.             options: {} as Record<string, VuexModule<any, any>>,
180.             injectStore: noop as (store: Store<any>) => void
181.           }
182.         )
183. 
184.     const gettersInstance = getters && initGetters(getters, this)
185.     const mutationsInstance = mutations && initMutations(mutations, this)
186.     const actionsInstance = actions && initActions(actions, this)
187. 
188.     return {
189.       options: {
190.         namespaced: namespaced === undefined ? true : namespaced,
191.         state: state ? new state() : {},
192.         getters: gettersInstance && gettersInstance.getters,
193.         mutations: mutationsInstance && mutationsInstance.mutations,
194.         actions: actionsInstance && actionsInstance.actions,
195.         modules: children && children.options
196.       },
197.       injectStore: combine(
198.         children ? children.injectStore : noop,
199.         gettersInstance ? gettersInstance.injectStore : noop,
200.         mutationsInstance ? mutationsInstance.injectStore : noop,
201.         actionsInstance ? actionsInstance.injectStore : noop
202.       )
203.     }
204.   }

207. function initGetters<
208.   S,
209.   G extends BG<S>,
210.   M extends BM<S>,
211.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
212. >(
213.   Getters: Class<G>,
214.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
215. ): { getters: GetterTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
216.   const getters: any = new Getters()
217.   const options: GetterTree<any, any> = {}
218. 
219.   // Proxy all getters to print useful warning on development
220.   function proxyGetters(getters: any, origin: string): any {
221.     const proxy = Object.create(getters)
222.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
223.       Object.defineProperty(proxy, key, {
224.         get() {
225.           error(
226.             `You are accessing ${Getters.name}#${key} from ${Getters.name}#${origin}` +
227.               ' but direct access to another getter is prohibitted.' +
228.               ` Access it via this.getters.${key} instead.`
229.           )
230.           return getters[key]
231.         },
232.         configurable: true
233.       })
234.     })
235.     return proxy
236.   }
237. 
238.   traverseDescriptors(Getters.prototype, BaseGetters, (desc, key) => {
239.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function' && !desc.get) {
240.       return
241.     }
242. 
243.     const methodFn = desc.value
244.     const getterFn = desc.get
245. 
246.     options[key] = () => {
247.       const proxy =
248.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
249.           ? getters
250.           : proxyGetters(getters, key)
251. 
252.       if (getterFn) {
253.         return getterFn.call(proxy)
254.       }
255. 
256.       if (methodFn) {
257.         return methodFn.bind(proxy)
258.       }
259.     }
260.   })
261. 
262.   return {
263.     getters: options,
264.     injectStore: store => {
265.       const context = module.context(store)
266. 
267.       Object.defineProperty(getters, '__ctx__', {
268.         get: () => context
269.       })
270. 
271.       getters.$init(store)
272.     }
273.   }
274. }

276. function initMutations<
277.   S,
278.   G extends BG<S>,
279.   M extends BM<S>,
280.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
281. >(
282.   Mutations: Class<M>,
283.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
284. ): { mutations: MutationTree<any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
285.   const mutations: any = new Mutations()
286.   const options: MutationTree<any> = {}
287. 
288.   // Proxy all mutations to print useful warning on development
289.   function proxyMutations(mutations: any, origin: string): any {
290.     const proxy = Object.create(mutations)
291.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
292.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
293.         error(
294.           `You are accessing ${Mutations.name}#${key} from ${Mutations.name}#${origin}` +
295.             ' but accessing another mutation is prohibitted.' +
296.             ' Use an action to consolidate the mutation chain.'
297.         )
298.         mutations[key].apply(mutations, args)
299.       }
300.     })
301.     return proxy
302.   }
303. 
304.   traverseDescriptors(Mutations.prototype, BaseMutations, (desc, key) => {
305.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
306.       return
307.     }
308. 
309.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {
310.       const proxy =
311.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
312.           ? mutations
313.           : proxyMutations(mutations, key)
314. 
315.       return mutations[key].call(proxy, payload)
316.     }
317.   })
318. 
319.   return {
320.     mutations: options,
321.     injectStore: store => {
322.       const context = module.context(store)
323.       Object.defineProperty(mutations, '__ctx__', {
324.         get: () => context
325.       })
326.     }
327.   }
328. }

330. function initActions<
331.   S,
332.   G extends BG<S>,
333.   M extends BM<S>,
334.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
335. >(
336.   Actions: Class<A>,
337.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
338. ): { actions: ActionTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
339.   const actions: any = new Actions()
340.   const options: ActionTree<any, any> = {}
341. 
342.   // Proxy all actions to print useful warning on development
343.   function proxyActions(actions: any, origin: string): any {
344.     const proxy = Object.create(actions)
345.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
346.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
347.         error(
348.           `You are accessing ${Actions.name}#${key} from ${Actions.name}#${origin}` +
349.             ' but direct access to another action is prohibitted.' +
350.             ` Access it via this.dispatch('${key}') instead.`
351.         )
352.         actions[key].apply(actions, args)
353.       }
354.     })
355.     return proxy
356.   }
357. 
358.   traverseDescriptors(Actions.prototype, BaseActions, (desc, key) => {
359.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
360.       return
361.     }
362. 
363.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {

138.   /* @internal */
139.   create(path: string[], namespace: string): ModuleInstance {
140.     assert(
141.       !this.path || this.path.join('.') === path.join('.'),
142.       'You are reusing one module on multiple places in the same store.\n' +
143.         'Clone it by `module.clone()` method to make sure every module in the store is unique.'
144.     )
145. 
146.     this.path = path
147.     this.namespace = namespace
148. 
149.     const {
150.       namespaced,
151.       state,
152.       getters,
153.       mutations,
154.       actions,
155.       modules
156.     } = this.options
157. 
158.     const children = !modules
159.       ? undefined
160.       : Object.keys(modules).reduce(
161.           (acc, key) => {
162.             const m = modules[key]
163.             const nextNamespaced =
164.               m.options.namespaced === undefined ? true : m.options.namespaced
165. 
166.             const nextNamespaceKey = nextNamespaced ? key + '/' : ''
167. 
168.             const res = m.create(
169.               path.concat(key),
170.               namespaced ? namespace + nextNamespaceKey : nextNamespaceKey
171.             )
172. 
173.             acc.options[key] = res.options
174.             acc.injectStore = combine(acc.injectStore, res.injectStore)
175. 
176.             return acc
177.           },
178.           {
179.             options: {} as Record<string, VuexModule<any, any>>,
180.             injectStore: noop as (store: Store<any>) => void
181.           }
182.         )
183. 
184.     const gettersInstance = getters && initGetters(getters, this)
185.     const mutationsInstance = mutations && initMutations(mutations, this)
186.     const actionsInstance = actions && initActions(actions, this)
187. 
188.     return {
189.       options: {
190.         namespaced: namespaced === undefined ? true : namespaced,
191.         state: state ? new state() : {},
192.         getters: gettersInstance && gettersInstance.getters,
193.         mutations: mutationsInstance && mutationsInstance.mutations,
194.         actions: actionsInstance && actionsInstance.actions,
195.         modules: children && children.options
196.       },
197.       injectStore: combine(
198.         children ? children.injectStore : noop,
199.         gettersInstance ? gettersInstance.injectStore : noop,
200.         mutationsInstance ? mutationsInstance.injectStore : noop,
201.         actionsInstance ? actionsInstance.injectStore : noop
202.       )
203.     }
204.   }

207. function initGetters<
208.   S,
209.   G extends BG<S>,
210.   M extends BM<S>,
211.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
212. >(
213.   Getters: Class<G>,
214.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
215. ): { getters: GetterTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
216.   const getters: any = new Getters()
217.   const options: GetterTree<any, any> = {}
218. 
219.   // Proxy all getters to print useful warning on development
220.   function proxyGetters(getters: any, origin: string): any {
221.     const proxy = Object.create(getters)
222.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
223.       Object.defineProperty(proxy, key, {
224.         get() {
225.           error(
226.             `You are accessing ${Getters.name}#${key} from ${Getters.name}#${origin}` +
227.               ' but direct access to another getter is prohibitted.' +
228.               ` Access it via this.getters.${key} instead.`
229.           )
230.           return getters[key]
231.         },
232.         configurable: true
233.       })
234.     })
235.     return proxy
236.   }
237. 
238.   traverseDescriptors(Getters.prototype, BaseGetters, (desc, key) => {
239.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function' && !desc.get) {
240.       return
241.     }
242. 
243.     const methodFn = desc.value
244.     const getterFn = desc.get
245. 
246.     options[key] = () => {
247.       const proxy =
248.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
249.           ? getters
250.           : proxyGetters(getters, key)
251. 
252.       if (getterFn) {
253.         return getterFn.call(proxy)
254.       }
255. 
256.       if (methodFn) {
257.         return methodFn.bind(proxy)
258.       }
259.     }
260.   })
261. 
262.   return {
263.     getters: options,
264.     injectStore: store => {
265.       const context = module.context(store)
266. 
267.       Object.defineProperty(getters, '__ctx__', {
268.         get: () => context
269.       })
270. 
271.       getters.$init(store)
272.     }
273.   }
274. }
275. 
276. function initMutations<
277.   S,
278.   G extends BG<S>,
279.   M extends BM<S>,
280.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
281. >(
282.   Mutations: Class<M>,
283.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
284. ): { mutations: MutationTree<any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
285.   const mutations: any = new Mutations()
286.   const options: MutationTree<any> = {}
287. 
288.   // Proxy all mutations to print useful warning on development
289.   function proxyMutations(mutations: any, origin: string): any {
290.     const proxy = Object.create(mutations)
291.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
292.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
293.         error(
294.           `You are accessing ${Mutations.name}#${key} from ${Mutations.name}#${origin}` +
295.             ' but accessing another mutation is prohibitted.' +
296.             ' Use an action to consolidate the mutation chain.'
297.         )
298.         mutations[key].apply(mutations, args)
299.       }
300.     })
301.     return proxy
302.   }
303. 
304.   traverseDescriptors(Mutations.prototype, BaseMutations, (desc, key) => {
305.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
306.       return
307.     }
308. 
309.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {
310.       const proxy =
311.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
312.           ? mutations
313.           : proxyMutations(mutations, key)
314. 
315.       return mutations[key].call(proxy, payload)
316.     }
317.   })
318. 
319.   return {
320.     mutations: options,
321.     injectStore: store => {
322.       const context = module.context(store)
323.       Object.defineProperty(mutations, '__ctx__', {
324.         get: () => context
325.       })
326.     }
327.   }
328. }
329. 
330. function initActions<
331.   S,
332.   G extends BG<S>,
333.   M extends BM<S>,
334.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
335. >(
336.   Actions: Class<A>,
337.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
338. ): { actions: ActionTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
339.   const actions: any = new Actions()
340.   const options: ActionTree<any, any> = {}
341. 
342.   // Proxy all actions to print useful warning on development
343.   function proxyActions(actions: any, origin: string): any {
344.     const proxy = Object.create(actions)
345.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
346.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
347.         error(
348.           `You are accessing ${Actions.name}#${key} from ${Actions.name}#${origin}` +
349.             ' but direct access to another action is prohibitted.' +
350.             ` Access it via this.dispatch('${key}') instead.`
351.         )
352.         actions[key].apply(actions, args)
353.       }
354.     })
355.     return proxy
356.   }
357. 
358.   traverseDescriptors(Actions.prototype, BaseActions, (desc, key) => {
359.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
360.       return
361.     }
362. 
363.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {
364.       const proxy =
365.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
366.           ? actions
367.           : proxyActions(actions, key)
368.       return actions[key].call(proxy, payload)
369.     }
370.   })
371. 
372.   return {
373.     actions: options,
374.     injectStore: store => {
375.       const context = module.context(store)
376. 
377.       Object.defineProperty(actions, '__ctx__', {
378.         get: () => context
379.       })
380. 
381.       actions.$init(store)
382.     }
383.   }

5. export function registerModule(
6.   store: Store<any>,
7.   path: string | string[],

9.   module: Module<any, any, any, any>,
10.   options?: ModuleOptions
11. ): void {

14.     normalizedPath,
15.     normalizeNamespace(namespace)

29. function normalizeNamespace(namespace: string | null): string {
30.   if (namespace === '' || namespace === null) {
31.     return ''
32.   }
33. 
34.   return namespace[namespace.length - 1] === '/' ? namespace : namespace + '/'

108. function normalizedDispatch(
109.   dispatch: Function,
110.   namespace: string,
111.   type: any,
112.   payload: any,
113.   options?: any
114. ): any {
115.   if (typeof type === 'string') {
116.     return dispatch(namespace + type, payload, options)
117.   } else {
118.     return dispatch(
119.       {
120.         ...type,
121.         type: namespace + type.type
122.       },
123.       payload

125.   }

148. export function getters(store: Store<any>, namespace: string): any {
149.   const sliceIndex = namespace.length
150.   const getters: Record<string, any> = {}
151. 
152.   Object.keys(store.getters).forEach(key => {
153.     const sameNamespace = namespace === key.slice(0, sliceIndex)
154.     const name = key.slice(sliceIndex)
155.     if (!sameNamespace || !name) {
156.       return
157.     }
158. 
159.     Object.defineProperty(getters, name, {
160.       get: () => store.getters[key],
161.       enumerable: true
162.     })
163.   })
164. 
165.   return getters

168. export class Context<Mod extends Module<any, any, any, any>> {
169.   private __mutations__?: Committer<Mutations<Mod>>
170.   private __actions__?: Dispatcher<Actions<Mod>>
171.   /** @internal */
172.   constructor(
173.     private pos: ContextPosition,
174.     private store: Store<any>,
175.     private mutationsClass: Class<unknown> | undefined,
176.     private actionsClass: Class<unknown> | undefined
177.   ) {}
178. 
179.   get mutations(): Committer<Mutations<Mod>> {
180.     if (this.__mutations__) {
181.       return this.__mutations__
182.     }
183.     const mutations: Record<string, any> = {}
184.     if (this.mutationsClass) {
185.       const mutationNames = gatherHandlerNames(
186.         this.mutationsClass.prototype,
187.         BaseMutations
188.       )
189.       mutationNames.forEach(name => {
190.         Object.defineProperty(mutations, name, {
191.           value: (payload: any) => this.commit(name, payload),
192.           enumerable: true
193.         })
194.       })
195.     }
196.     return (this.__mutations__ = mutations as any)
197.   }
198. 
199.   get actions(): Dispatcher<Actions<Mod>> {
200.     if (this.__actions__) {
201.       return this.__actions__
202.     }
203.     const actions: Record<string, any> = {}
204.     if (this.actionsClass) {
205.       const actionNames = gatherHandlerNames(
206.         this.actionsClass.prototype,
207.         BaseActions
208.       )
209.       actionNames.forEach(name => {
210.         Object.defineProperty(actions, name, {
211.           value: (payload: any) => this.dispatch(name, payload),
212.           enumerable: true
213.         })
214.       })
215.     }
216.     return (this.__actions__ = actions as any)
217.   }

219.   commit: Commit<Mutations<Mod>> = (
220.     type: any,
221.     payload?: any,
222.     options?: any
223.   ): void => {
224.     return commit(this.store, this.pos.namespace, type, payload, options)
225.   }
226. 
227.   dispatch: Dispatch<Actions<Mod>> = (
228.     type: any,
229.     payload?: any,
230.     options?: any
231.   ): any => {
232.     return dispatch(this.store, this.pos.namespace, type, payload, options)
233.   }
234. 
235.   get state(): State<Mod> {
236.     return get(this.pos.path, this.store.state)
237.   }
238. 
239.   get getters(): Getters<Mod> {
240.     return getters(this.store, this.pos.namespace)
241.   }

22. export function inject<T>(
23.   F: Class<T>,
24.   injection: Partial<T> & Record<string, any>
25. ): T {
26.   const proto = F.prototype
27. 
28.   const descs: PropertyDescriptorMap = {}
29.   Object.keys(injection).forEach(key => {
30.     descs[key] = {
31.       configurable: true,
32.       enumerable: true,
33.       writable: true,
34.       value: injection[key]
35.     }
36.   })

75.

77.     return this.__ctx__.state

79.

82.   }

86.   }

93.    * IMPORTANT: Each action type maybe incorrect - return type of all actions should be `Promise<any>`

138.   /* @internal */
139.   create(path: string[], namespace: string): ModuleInstance {
140.     assert(
141.       !this.path || this.path.join('.') === path.join('.'),
142.       'You are reusing one module on multiple places in the same store.\n' +
143.         'Clone it by `module.clone()` method to make sure every module in the store is unique.'
144.     )
145. 
146.     this.path = path
147.     this.namespace = namespace
148. 
149.     const {
150.       namespaced,
151.       state,
152.       getters,
153.       mutations,
154.       actions,
155.       modules
156.     } = this.options
157. 
158.     const children = !modules
159.       ? undefined
160.       : Object.keys(modules).reduce(
161.           (acc, key) => {
162.             const m = modules[key]
163.             const nextNamespaced =
164.               m.options.namespaced === undefined ? true : m.options.namespaced
165. 
166.             const nextNamespaceKey = nextNamespaced ? key + '/' : ''
167. 
168.             const res = m.create(
169.               path.concat(key),
170.               namespaced ? namespace + nextNamespaceKey : nextNamespaceKey
171.             )
172. 
173.             acc.options[key] = res.options
174.             acc.injectStore = combine(acc.injectStore, res.injectStore)
175. 
176.             return acc
177.           },
178.           {
179.             options: {} as Record<string, VuexModule<any, any>>,
180.             injectStore: noop as (store: Store<any>) => void
181.           }
182.         )
183. 
184.     const gettersInstance = getters && initGetters(getters, this)
185.     const mutationsInstance = mutations && initMutations(mutations, this)
186.     const actionsInstance = actions && initActions(actions, this)
187. 
188.     return {
189.       options: {
190.         namespaced: namespaced === undefined ? true : namespaced,
191.         state: state ? new state() : {},
192.         getters: gettersInstance && gettersInstance.getters,
193.         mutations: mutationsInstance && mutationsInstance.mutations,
194.         actions: actionsInstance && actionsInstance.actions,
195.         modules: children && children.options
196.       },
197.       injectStore: combine(
198.         children ? children.injectStore : noop,
199.         gettersInstance ? gettersInstance.injectStore : noop,
200.         mutationsInstance ? mutationsInstance.injectStore : noop,
201.         actionsInstance ? actionsInstance.injectStore : noop
202.       )
203.     }
204.   }
205. }

207. function initGetters<
208.   S,
209.   G extends BG<S>,
210.   M extends BM<S>,
211.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
212. >(
213.   Getters: Class<G>,
214.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
215. ): { getters: GetterTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
216.   const getters: any = new Getters()
217.   const options: GetterTree<any, any> = {}
218. 
219.   // Proxy all getters to print useful warning on development
220.   function proxyGetters(getters: any, origin: string): any {
221.     const proxy = Object.create(getters)
222.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
223.       Object.defineProperty(proxy, key, {
224.         get() {
225.           error(
226.             `You are accessing ${Getters.name}#${key} from ${Getters.name}#${origin}` +
227.               ' but direct access to another getter is prohibitted.' +
228.               ` Access it via this.getters.${key} instead.`
229.           )
230.           return getters[key]
231.         },
232.         configurable: true
233.       })
234.     })
235.     return proxy
236.   }
237. 
238.   traverseDescriptors(Getters.prototype, BaseGetters, (desc, key) => {
239.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function' && !desc.get) {
240.       return
241.     }
242. 
243.     const methodFn = desc.value
244.     const getterFn = desc.get
245. 
246.     options[key] = () => {
247.       const proxy =
248.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
249.           ? getters
250.           : proxyGetters(getters, key)
251. 
252.       if (getterFn) {
253.         return getterFn.call(proxy)
254.       }
255. 
256.       if (methodFn) {
257.         return methodFn.bind(proxy)
258.       }
259.     }
260.   })
261. 
262.   return {
263.     getters: options,
264.     injectStore: store => {
265.       const context = module.context(store)
266. 
267.       Object.defineProperty(getters, '__ctx__', {
268.         get: () => context
269.       })
270. 
271.       getters.$init(store)
272.     }
273.   }
274. }

276. function initMutations<
277.   S,
278.   G extends BG<S>,
279.   M extends BM<S>,
280.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
281. >(
282.   Mutations: Class<M>,
283.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
284. ): { mutations: MutationTree<any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
285.   const mutations: any = new Mutations()
286.   const options: MutationTree<any> = {}
287. 
288.   // Proxy all mutations to print useful warning on development
289.   function proxyMutations(mutations: any, origin: string): any {
290.     const proxy = Object.create(mutations)
291.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
292.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
293.         error(
294.           `You are accessing ${Mutations.name}#${key} from ${Mutations.name}#${origin}` +
295.             ' but accessing another mutation is prohibitted.' +
296.             ' Use an action to consolidate the mutation chain.'
297.         )
298.         mutations[key].apply(mutations, args)
299.       }
300.     })
301.     return proxy
302.   }
303. 
304.   traverseDescriptors(Mutations.prototype, BaseMutations, (desc, key) => {
305.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
306.       return
307.     }
308. 
309.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {
310.       const proxy =
311.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
312.           ? mutations
313.           : proxyMutations(mutations, key)
314. 
315.       return mutations[key].call(proxy, payload)
316.     }
317.   })
318. 
319.   return {
320.     mutations: options,
321.     injectStore: store => {
322.       const context = module.context(store)
323.       Object.defineProperty(mutations, '__ctx__', {
324.         get: () => context
325.       })
326.     }
327.   }
328. }

330. function initActions<
331.   S,
332.   G extends BG<S>,
333.   M extends BM<S>,
334.   A extends BA<S, G, M>
335. >(
336.   Actions: Class<A>,
337.   module: Module<S, G, M, A>
338. ): { actions: ActionTree<any, any>; injectStore: (store: Store<any>) => void } {
339.   const actions: any = new Actions()
340.   const options: ActionTree<any, any> = {}
341. 
342.   // Proxy all actions to print useful warning on development
343.   function proxyActions(actions: any, origin: string): any {
344.     const proxy = Object.create(actions)
345.     Object.keys(options).forEach(key => {
346.       proxy[key] = (...args: any[]) => {
347.         error(
348.           `You are accessing ${Actions.name}#${key} from ${Actions.name}#${origin}` +
349.             ' but direct access to another action is prohibitted.' +
350.             ` Access it via this.dispatch('${key}') instead.`
351.         )
352.         actions[key].apply(actions, args)
353.       }
354.     })
355.     return proxy
356.   }
357. 
358.   traverseDescriptors(Actions.prototype, BaseActions, (desc, key) => {
359.     if (typeof desc.value !== 'function') {
360.       return
361.     }
362. 
363.     options[key] = (_: any, payload: any) => {
364.       const proxy =
365.         process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
366.           ? actions
367.           : proxyActions(actions, key)
368.       return actions[key].call(proxy, payload)
369.     }
370.   })
371. 
372.   return {
373.     actions: options,
374.     injectStore: store => {
375.       const context = module.context(store)
376. 
377.       Object.defineProperty(actions, '__ctx__', {
378.         get: () => context
379.       })
380. 
381.       actions.$init(store)
382.     }
383.   }
384. }

185.       const mutationNames = gatherHandlerNames(
186.         this.mutationsClass.prototype,

190.         Object.defineProperty(mutations, name, {
191.           value: (payload: any) => this.commit(name, payload),

193.         })
194.       })
195.     }
196.     return (this.__mutations__ = mutations as any)
197.   }

199.   get actions(): Dispatcher<Actions<Mod>> {
200.     if (this.__actions__) {
201.       return this.__actions__

204.     if (this.actionsClass) {
205.       const actionNames = gatherHandlerNames(
206.         this.actionsClass.prototype,
207.         BaseActions
208.       )
209.       actionNames.forEach(name => {
210.         Object.defineProperty(actions, name, {
211.           value: (payload: any) => this.dispatch(name, payload),
212.           enumerable: true
213.         })
214.       })
215.     }
216.     return (this.__actions__ = actions as any)
217.   }
